# Version 3.119.3
> **Servicing preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/3.119.3-preview.1.1)

> **Superseded by [3.119.4](3.119.4.md)** · Never released as stable — these changes rolled up into 3.119.4.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](3.119.3/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.1.4/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.119.3 preview fixes Linux ARM64 initialization and Ahead-of-Time runtime crashes. It also refreshes bundled native dependencies and advances native binary mitigation coverage.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux ARM64 font initialization fixed** — Adds the fontconfig runtime dependency to the cross-compile sysroot to prevent Linux ARM64 startup crashes. ([#3494](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3494))
- **Ahead-of-Time reflection-disabled crash fixed** — Applications compiled with IlcDisableReflection no longer fail during SkiaSharp initialization. ([#3485](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3485))

## Security

- **Bundled native dependencies refreshed** — Updates libpng, libwebp, Brotli, and expat used by the packaged native assets. ([#3452](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3452), [#3458](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3458), [#3469](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3469), [#3478](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3478))

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.4

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.
